claims: Ewan McGregor is married to American actress Mary Elizabeth Winstead.
Ewan McGregor and Mary Elizabeth Winstead married in April 2022.
Ewan McGregor and Mary Elizabeth Winstead met on the set of the FX series Fargo in 2016.
Mary Elizabeth Winstead appeared in 10 Cloverfield Lane.
Mary Elizabeth Winstead appeared in Scott Pilgrim vs. the World.
Mary Elizabeth Winstead plays Hera Syndulla in the Star Wars series Ahsoka.
Ewan McGregor and Mary Elizabeth Winstead have a son named Laurie born in June 2021.
Ewan McGregor and Mary Elizabeth Winstead appeared in Birds of Prey (2020).
Ewan McGregor and Mary Elizabeth Winstead appeared in A Gentleman in Moscow (2024).
Ewan McGregor was married to production designer Eve Mavrakis for 22 years (1995–2020).
